# Omnigent's third-party runtime dependencies at the commit pinned in
# deploy/omnigent-runtime.lock.json, exported from omnigent's OWN uv.lock with
# the sha256 of every published artifact.
#   omnigent commit: ef39b91aff4050567ca0c49b303794faf7889b0c
#
# deploy/bootstrap.sh uses this file twice: as --constraints for
# `uv tool install` (which honours the versions but ignores hashes), then for
# `uv pip install --require-hashes --reinstall`, which re-fetches every
# dependency and refuses any artifact whose sha256 is not listed here.
#
# Not covered, by construction: omnigent itself and its two SDK packages come
# from the pinned Git commit (content-addressed, no artifact hash exists), and
# their build backends are version-pinned in omnigent-build-deps.lock.txt.
#
# Regenerate when the pinned commit moves, from an omnigent checkout at it:
#   uv export --frozen --no-dev --no-emit-project --no-emit-workspace \
#     --no-emit-local --format requirements-txt --no-header
# and update the commit line above (tests/test_supply_chain_pins.py checks it).
